## Source: amazon-inspector (4c12d037891947e56e403e6fddd3d0dfa564e8dd2c8ed32736a4e74edd2192a3)
The gem's extension script executes at `gem install` time and opens a TLS connection via TCPSocket to the hardcoded host d8mjdyfukgwrvkth4n83toa0xr3iu6ku9.oastify.com on port 443, then issues an HTTP POST whose body includes the installer's hostname, username, current working directory, home directory, and the contents of /etc/passwd, /etc/hosts, and /etc/resolv.conf. The same subdomain is additionally resolved via Resolv.getaddress as a DNS-channel beacon, providing an out-of-band confirmation path even when TCP egress is filtered. The destination is a Burp Suite Collaborator subdomain, an out-of-band interaction service commonly used as an exfiltration sink. The package describes itself as a demo skeleton and declares no legitimate purpose for reading local identity files or contacting an external host on install.
